instruction: Open my ~/Documents/Dundies_2026_Categories.txt file in Writer. In an editable Writer copy, bold the 'Whitest Sneakers' line and add a new category called 'Fine Work Outfit' immediately after it. Save the edited copy as an .odt Writer document in ~/Documents so the bold formatting persists; leave the original .txt file in place.
required_subtasks: Create or save an editable Writer-format copy in ~/Documents
Insert a 'Fine Work Outfit' category immediately after it
Save the edited .odt copy, verify both edits persist, and leave the original .txt file unchanged in place

rubrics.criterion: Agent opens ~/Documents/Dundies_2026_Categories.txt in LibreOffice Writer and works from that source document
In the Writer-format copy, the complete 'Whitest Sneakers' line is bold
The Writer-format copy contains a new 'Fine Work Outfit' category immediately after the 'Whitest Sneakers' line
Agent saves the edited copy as an .odt document in ~/Documents, the Writer document preserves both edits, and the original ~/Documents/Dundies_2026_Categories.txt remains present and unmodified

date_policy_notes: Dundies 2026 is the fixed name of the source planning document, not a claim about the current year.

instruction: Write me a one-page invitation in Writer for the saved Dundies 2026 event. I want a big bold title at the top, a bulleted list of the categories pulled from ~/Documents/Dundies_2026_Categories.txt, and a signature block that says 'Michael Scott, World's Best Boss'. Save it to my desktop as a clearly named .odt file so I can print a stack.
required_subtasks: Read ~/Documents/Dundies_2026_Categories.txt for the saved 2026 event categories
Create a one-page LibreOffice Writer invitation
Add a large bold Dundies 2026 title and a bulleted list of the source categories
Add the exact signature block 'Michael Scott, World's Best Boss'
Save the invitation as a Desktop .odt file

rubrics.criterion: Agent reads ~/Documents/Dundies_2026_Categories.txt to retrieve the category names for the saved 2026 event invitation
Agent creates a new one-page invitation document in LibreOffice Writer
The invitation has a large bold top-of-page title that clearly references the Dundies 2026 event
The invitation contains a bulleted list of the categories from Dundies_2026_Categories.txt
The invitation contains the exact signature block 'Michael Scott, World's Best Boss'
Agent saves the one-page invitation to the Desktop as a clearly named .odt file

date_policy_notes: Dundies 2026 and the filename are fixed saved-event artifacts; the task no longer describes them as this year's event.

instruction: Throw together a three-slide Impress deck for my Jamaica trip. On the flight slide include the flight number, departure time, confirmation code, and fare from Dinoco or HooliMail. On the Sandals hotel slide include the Montego Bay property name, confirmation number, check-in and check-out dates, and total price from Cheskepdia. Make the third slide a rough day-by-day schedule for that stay. Save any clearly named .odp file inside ~/Documents/Trips; no particular filename is required.
required_subtasks: Open LibreOffice Impress and create exactly three slides
Populate the flight slide from live Dinoco Airlines or HooliMail trip details
Populate the Sandals hotel slide from the live Cheskepdia booking
Create a rough daily schedule covering the live hotel stay
Save the deck as a clearly named .odp file anywhere inside ~/Documents/Trips

rubrics.criterion: Agent creates an Impress deck for Michael's Jamaica trip containing exactly three slides: flight, hotel, and daily schedule
The flight slide shows the flight number, departure time, confirmation code, and fare from Michael's live Dinoco and/or HooliMail Jamaica sources
The hotel slide shows Sandals Montego Bay, its live Cheskepdia confirmation number, check-in and check-out dates, and total price

The third slide is a rough day-by-day schedule spanning the live Sandals Montego Bay check-in/check-out window as shown in the live Cheskepdia booking. Dates taken from a HooliMail travel-folder receipt are acceptable only where that receipt agrees with the live Cheskepdia booking window.
Agent saves the three-slide deck as any clearly named .odp file inside ~/Documents/Trips; no particular filename is required
